title: Monaco Grand Prix
metaDescription: Monaco Grand Prix: source-backed dates, circuit and visitor planning for this Formula 1 race.

overview.about: The Monaco Grand Prix is the most glamorous and demanding race in Formula 1 — a tight street circuit through Monte Carlo where overtaking is almost impossible and qualifying is everything. Run since 1929 and part of the world championship from its first season in 1950, its barriers, tunnel and harbour chicane punish the smallest mistake. Ayrton Senna's six wins here are the all-time record. The 2027 race is on 4-6 June.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Monaco Grand Prix runs 4-6 June around the streets of Monte Carlo. At about 3.3 km it is the shortest lap on the calendar and the race distance is cut to roughly 260 km - the only Grand Prix under the usual 305 km - because the cars are so slow through the corners.

@graph.description: The Monaco Grand Prix is Formula 1’s street race through Monte Carlo and La Condamine, using the Circuit de Monaco. The first Monaco Grand Prix was held in 1929 and the race was part of the inaugural Formula 1 World Championship season in 1950. Its narrow roads, elevation changes and barriers make passing difficult and place unusual weight on qualifying position and pit strategy. The existing OneSliders page records the edition calendar in Event JSON-LD, and that stated date is used here rather than a projected replacement. The weekend follows Formula 1’s practice, qualifying and race structure, while official race organisers control the detailed schedule, grandstand access and transport restrictions.
